kebab_example: aliyun easygene create-entity --workspace test-workspace --entity-type sample --entity-items '[{"EntityName":"s1","EntityData":{"key":"example-string"}}]' --client-token T93cy1mMDE4OTgxNGU1ZTkK --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEntity

parameters.help_zh: 工作空间，获取方式请参见创建工作空间 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601899.html?spm=a2c4g.601898.0.0.2df07010mNFomF)
